'''Churnis''' was a member of the [[Imperial Guard]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. At the time of the [[Battle of Corellia]], he was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] guarding the Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Alvon Zamar]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Churnis appears in the Imperial Agent class mission "Eve of Destruction" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He can be killed by players upon meeting him, but if they do so, a second NPC also named "Imperial Guard Churnis" will be guarding Moff Zamar inside his shuttle.<ref name="SWTOR" />
